'''Colly Garren''' was a resident of the [[Two Rivers]]. 

== Activities ==
When [[Perrin Aybara]] sets up an ambush for a group of [[Trollocs]] in the Two Rivers, they are betrayed by Lord [[Slayer#Luc Mantear|Luc]]  and Colly was killed when the Trollocs then ambush Perrin's group.{{ref/book|4|40}}
